title: Light the Night Kayak Tour in Vancouver
includes: All necessary equipment, including life jackets
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Minimum age is 10 years (front of double kayak with adult in the back). 16 years for single kayak with a waiver signed by a guardian.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Light your own path as the sun goes down – literally! Watch as your equipment comes to life, and streaks through the water with colorful light. Our Light The Night Tour leaves at sunset and is approximately 2 hours long. Quickly becoming one of the most popular paddling experiences around the world, this guided tour is a fun way to ring in the weekend and discover Vancouver at night.
